comment: Settings for watch/watch_sources.py, watch/coverage.py and watch/validate_db.py. 'families' are the places a measurement can come from; every measurement set in the database must match exactly one family through its 'source' text, so data from different sources is never blended. 'rank' orders the families by how far their measurements can be trusted (1 = most reliable; equal numbers are equally reliable) and 'reliability' is the short label the viewer shows next to the source. 'sources' are the sites the weekly scan reads. Each belongs to one family, lists the model-number 'patterns' it applies, and says which of its pages are measurement pages ('measurement_url'); a model is only reported when it appears on a measurement page. 'start' URLs may be HTML pages or XML sitemaps. 'follow' is a pattern for same-site links to read from the start pages (null: none); 'follow_recursive' also follows them from followed pages. 'delay_s' is the pause between pages. 'patterns' maps a pattern name to {brand, regex}; a named group 'model' narrows the match. Add a model number to 'ignore' to stop it being reported. 'aliases' maps short forms some sites use (for example audiohorn's SB17NBAC-4) to the full model number.

families.name: Manufacturer datasheet
families.reliability_note: Purifi's own datasheet measurements: the most reliable source. SB Acoustics and BlieSMa publish no distortion measurements.

families.name: HiFiCompass
families.reliability_note: Second to Purifi's datasheets; state-of-the-art lab measurements.

families.name: Erin's Audio Corner
families.reliability_note: Less reliable than Purifi's datasheets and HiFiCompass.

families.name: audioXpress
families.reliability_note: Less reliable than Purifi's datasheets and HiFiCompass.

families.name: diyAudio
families.reliability_note: Some measurements are well made, most are not: judge each one on its own.

families.name: Parts Express
families.reliability_note: Some measurements are well made, most are not: judge each one on its own.

families.name: Derived (model or calculation)
families.reliability_note: Calculated from other data, not measured.

sources.name: audioXpress
sources.note: Only the tag listing pages are read (robots.txt: Crawl-delay 5; it blocks Anthropic's own crawlers, so articles are never fetched automatically).

excluded_sources.name: SB Acoustics (sbacoustics.com)
excluded_sources.reason: Publishes no distortion measurements. SB and Satori drivers are still found through the test labs.

excluded_sources.name: BlieSMa (bliesma.de)
excluded_sources.reason: Publishes no distortion measurements. BlieSMa drivers are still found through the test labs.

aliases.comment: Short forms some sites use, mapped to the full model number. Keys are written as found; identities are never merged, so an alias must name the exact variant (same impedance).

capture.comment: Resolution for curves digitised onto a logarithmic frequency axis, in points per decade. 1/24 octave = 80 points per decade (target); 1/12 octave = 40 (minimum, below it the validator warns). See CAPTURE.md.
